title: Coverage Format Bugfix + CLI Unification
description: Fix `coverage run --report-format json` always failing with CoveragePlanError after the playtest session completes by making json a first-class report format mirroring the coverage-diff JSON shape; unify the --format vs --report-format flag naming across coverage subcommands with click.Choice validation, keep --format as a hidden backwards-compatible alias on `coverage report`, and align the [coverage].format config validator with the same format set.
